name: BROSIER/CUNNINGHAM RES
address: 2441 NW SKYLINE RANCH RD, BEND, OR 97703

fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker visible from the road at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responders arriving under low-light or smoke conditions can identify it without hesitation.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles so responding units can reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway edges so fire and emergency vehicles can pass through without delay.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around the buildings on foot.
• Clear a flat, open area near the parking zone that responding units can use to turn around or reposition equipment.
• Keep a gate or marked opening in the perimeter fencing accessible to responders approaching the detached structure.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and detached structure so responders can move directly between the two buildings.
• Keep the walkway clear of yard equipment, garden materials, and debris so responders can move quickly on foot.
• Post the property address on both the street-facing entrance and on the main residence so it is readable from multiple approach directions.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang close to or over any structure on the property.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structures to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that are growing directly against or touching any structure.
• Separate shrubs from the base of structures by clearing a bare or low-growth buffer immediately around the building perimeter.
• Thin scattered trees near structures so individual tree canopies are not touching each other.
• Remove dead branches and dry plant material from shrubs near any structure.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches, encroaching shrubs, and debris along its full length.
• Maintain the driveway or access road width so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Thin vegetation along the edges of the access route to keep the travel surface visible and passable.
• Move any stored wood, furniture, or flammable materials away from the sides of structures and into a more open area.
• Keep the open green space free of dead plant buildup, dry grass, and scattered debris that could carry fire toward structures.
